events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Sumner, better known as Sting, the iconic frontman of The Police and successful solo artist, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Enduring Legend
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the legendary Sting! From The Police to his incredible solo career, what's your favourite track from the Geordie icon?

events.title: The iPod turns 25
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple unveiled the very first iPod, revolutionising how we listen to music on the go.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first time you got your hands on an iPod? 25 years since Apple changed the game for portable music. How many songs could you fit on yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated worldwide as James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate 007 theme song? Licence to thrill us with your choices!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' co-founder and peace activist, John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th to the one and only John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped on this day in '68. Which track from the legendary double LP is your absolute favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Freddie Mercury today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Impact
angles.copy: 59 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that pushed boundaries – which track still stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon and peace advocate John Lennon, who was fatally shot in New York City in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: 46 years ago, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. What's his most meaningful song to you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today, born in 1947.

angles.name: Bowie's Influence
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. David Bowie's influence on music, fashion and culture is immeasurable. What's your favourite era of Bowie?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Celebrating the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have turned 92 today, born in 1935.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: What a legacy! Remembering Elvis Presley on what would have been his 92nd birthday. The King's music still reigns supreme.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock 'n' roll forever. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the distinctive-voiced rock and pop icon, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: A True Rocker
angles.copy: Happy 82nd to the one and only Rod Stewart! What's your go-to song from his incredible career?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Legend
angles.copy: Our House in the middle of our feed! Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the legendary frontman of Madness. What's your favourite nutty sound?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young, known for his distinctive blue-eyed soul voice and 80s hits, celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Wherever He Lays His Hat
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still got 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' on repeat? What's your favourite track from the blue-eyed soul legend?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The incomparable country music legend Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon, songwriter, and force of nature. What's your favourite Dolly hit?
